text:
maria: heads-up — a customer hit duplicate side-effects during onboarding when token refresh + 429 collided. support case shows SDK replayed the mutating request.
sam: can you paste a tiny sanitized trace?
maria:
```
2026-03-21T09:21:09Z req=xyz123 status=429 retry-after=0.3
2026-03-21T09:21:09Z client retried req=xyz123 idempotency_key=none
2026-03-21T09:21:10Z server processed create_item idempotency_key=none
```
raja: sounds like SDK retried aggressively during token rotate. quick wins: (1) sample apps should set an Idempotency-Key by default for mutating calls (opt-out), (2) SDKs should respect Retry-After and use jittered backoff, (3) add a very small sampling header so infra can correlate a few throttled requests without PII.
sam: agree. for sampling: keep it boolean + short tags, e.g. `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample: 1` and `X-Rw-Sample-Info: v=1;sdk=py;tag=throttle` only when sampling is active. no payloads, no user ids.
maria: pseudocode we can include in sample apps:
```js
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = opts.idempotencyKey || uuidv4()
if (didThrottle) headers['X-Rw-Throttle-Sample'] = '1'
await retryBackoff({baseMs:200, maxMs:30000, jitter:true, honorRetryAfter:true})
```
raja: also callout: streaming/generation endpoints should NOT enable auto-idempotency by default. long-running streams are different. add an explicit doc section.
ci-bot: created issue devex-846: "sample-app idempotency + throttle-sampling RFC" (assignee: @raja) :spiral_note_pad:
sam: action items: devex draft RFC with compatibility plan for older SDKs; eng-runtime to accept sample header and index boolean marker pre-scrub; SDKs to add opt-in sample info emission; docs to update onboarding guide.
maria: thanks — will start RFC draft and link here. keeps support noise down. :thumbsup:
